bio: A word to the wise: make sure you book, as this really appealing restaurant is always busy! Housed in an old railway station dating from 1903, the atmosphere is laid-back, the decor modern with industrial charm and the food excellent. On the blackboard there is a seasonal set menu – choose between meat, fish and vegetarian for the main course. They also have a selection of German wines. Dine at the counter to watch the chefs at work in the open kitchen....
